mapper.sql: create_time , update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, business_price_id, project_id, monomer_id, area_id, product_type, product_id, quantity, pricing_manner_enum, pricing_unit_type_enum, pricing_weight_type_enum, unit_price, total_price, audit_status
mapper.select:
select e.id as product_id, 4 product_type, e.project_id 'project.id', c.name 'project.name', c.short_name 'project.short_name', c.serial_number 'project.serial_number',
e.enclosure_plan_id 'area.id', ep.name 'area.name', e.category,
e.name, e.serial_number, e.plate as specification, e.material, e.quantity - ifnull(sum(d.quantity), 0) as quantity, e.length, (e.quantity - ifnull(sum(d.quantity), 0)) * e.length / 1000 as total_length, e.width, e.unfolded_width, e.weight, (e.quantity - ifnull(sum(d.quantity), 0)) * e.weight as total_weight, e.surface_area / 1000000 as surface_area, (e.quantity - ifnull(sum(d.quantity), 0)) * e.surface_area / 1000000 as total_area from tech_enclosure as e left join business_price_detail as d on e.id = d.product_id and d.bool_delete_enum = 0 and d.product_type = 4 and d.branch_company_id = #{branchCompanyId} and d.audit_status in (1, 2) left join contract_project as c on e.project_id = c.id left join enclosure_plan as ep on e.enclosure_plan_id = ep.id
where e.bool_delete_enum = 0
and e.project_id = #{projectId}
and e.name like concat('%', #{name},'%')
and e.serial_number like concat('%', #{serialNumber},'%')
and e.plate like concat('%', #{specification},'%')
and a.material like concat('%', #{material},'%')
group by e.id having quantity > 0 order by e.id
